retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, industrial composition featuring a group portrait framed by the open door of a weathered metal boxcar with heavy textures and stencil-style typography.
excludeWhen: sleek digital interfaces are the subject

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five people posed within the dark, cavernous opening of a weathered metal train car. The scene is dominated by deep blues and blacks, with heavy industrial textures like rivets, corrugated metal, and chalk-like graffiti. The composition is framed by the vertical lines of the boxcar door, with typography integrated into the metal surfaces.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between human figures and cold metal
Integration of text as environmental signage
Diagonal movement created by the railcar steps
coreInvariants: Weathered metal texture with visible rivets
Deep blue and charcoal color palette
Framed central subject within a dark aperture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central group portrait, medium-long shot, framed by the rectangular opening of the boxcar.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open doorway of the train car acts as a dark frame for the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left title, down the vertical door frame to the subjects, then right toward the side-panel text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, textured negative space on the left and right panels of the train car.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and Light Blue (Typography and Highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark interior and the subjects' faces.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or vibrant primary colors
Maintain a desaturated, aged film look

letterConstructionRules: Top header uses a heavy, blocky stencil with vertical cutouts
Side text uses a mix of condensed sans-serif and a fluid, upright script
Chalk-like hand-drawn graffiti on the left panel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top header are segmented by horizontal and vertical gaps to mimic metal stencils
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Industrial block stencil paired with a fluid, informal script for a 'freight car' aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy industrial stencil look of the header.
Approximates the informal, hand-painted feel of the side text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, industrial scene of a weathered blue-black metal boxcar with an open door. Include visible rivets, corrugated textures, and a group of five people in 1970s attire standing in the doorway. Add faint chalk-like graffiti on the left panel.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a heavy, condensed stencil font in white at the top left. Add a light blue script and condensed sans-serif text on the right panel, ensuring it looks weathered and integrated into the metal surface.

verificationChecks: Does the script text look hand-painted on the metal?
Is the lighting moody and focused on the central figures?

adjustableVariables: Color of the boxcar (blue vs green)
Number of people in the doorway
mustRedesign: Avoid using modern digital fonts without distressing
Do not use clean, flat backgrounds; must be textured metal

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Check for stencil gaps in the header text
Ensure the graffiti looks like hand-drawn chalk
Verify the subjects are framed by the door opening
Confirm the color palette is dominated by deep blues and blacks
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Boxcar + 70s Band Portrait + Stencil/Script Typography Mix
